dominant_strengths: Dark canvas with vibrant gradient screenshot creates strong visceral pull and showcases the product's polished output convincingly
Clean centered hierarchy with confident headline, single CTA, and macOS-recommended subtext reads as native and trustworthy
Demo image embodies the product itself — high craft visibility through smooth corners, shadow, and webcam composite
dominant_weaknesses: Cookie banner intrudes on hero focal point, blocking the demo's lower edge and weakening first-impression composition
Top nav feels generic and floats untethered with weak visual relationship to the centered hero block below
Headline typography is competent but unremarkable — no distinctive voice, weight contrast, or rhythm to match the product's polish
fix_priorities: Redesign cookie consent as a smaller corner toast so it does not occlude the hero demo
Elevate headline with tighter tracking, optical sizing, or accent color on 'high-impact' to add typographic personality
Anchor nav with subtle divider or backdrop blur to integrate it with the hero
Consider a looping video or subtle parallax of the demo to demonstrate motion craft promised by the product
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral via the gradient demo, adequate behavioral clarity through one CTA, but reflective depth is limited by generic copy and cookie interruption.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — clearly communicates a macOS screen recorder with a confident hero demo, though the cookie overlay undermines the intended polish.
